ERROR_FISCAL_YEAR_LOCKED: Fiscal year is locked or closed.
ERROR_OPENING_ENTRY_NOT_FIRST: Opening entry must be the first entry of the fiscal year.
ERROR_OPENING_ENTRY_DATE_MISMATCH: Opening entry date must match fiscal year start date.
ERROR_OPENING_ENTRY_INVALID_ACCOUNT_CLAS: Opening entry can only use Balance Sheet accounts (Classes 1-5).
